# ANVIL Engineering Workbench
> The Deterministic Verification Layer for AI Coding Agents.

ANVIL is an open-source, local-first verification harness and Model Context Protocol (MCP) server. Any AI coding agent — Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Antigravity, OpenCode — writes the code; ANVIL verifies it locally (blast radius, policy-as-code, secrets, tests) before it merges. Zero source code or tokens are sent to third-party LLMs.

## Core Capabilities
- **Deterministic Architecture Mapping:** Multi-language import graph across TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, Go, Rust, Java, Kotlin, C/C++, C#, Ruby, PHP; TypeScript AST symbol analysis in <1,400 compact tokens.
- **Change Risk & Blast Radius:** AST-backed dependency tracing from uncommitted git diffs to downstream impacted modules and recommended test candidates.
- **Pre-Commit Quality & Security Gate:** Local policy-as-code gate (`anvil gate`) with content-hash baselines (`.anvil/baseline.json`), secret entropy scanning, inline suppression governance, and SARIF export.
- **Git Pre-Commit Hook:** 1-command hook management (`anvil hook install` / `anvil hook remove`) ensuring code is verified before every commit.
- **Transactional Workspace Cleanup:** Dry-run preview and cleanup of build caches, temp files, and orphan source modules with atomic snapshot rollback (`anvil clean --undo <backupId>`).
- **Context Budget Protection:** Compact summaries by default (`detail: false`) with structured `_meta` token estimations saving 96–99% context tokens compared to raw file reads.

## Quick Start
```bash
# Run one-shot gate check (no install needed)
npx -y anvil-engineering-workbench@1.2.0 gate

# Install globally
npm install -g anvil-engineering-workbench

# Initialize repository baseline and policy
anvil init

# Inspect project tech stack & scripts
anvil inspect

# Map architecture & circular dependencies
anvil map

# Check change risk of working tree
anvil git

# Install git pre-commit hook
anvil hook install

# Start MCP server for AI assistants
anvil mcp start
```

## MCP Setup for Coding Agents
- **Claude Code:** `claude mcp add anvil -- npx -y anvil-engineering-workbench mcp start`
- **Cursor:** Add command `npx -y anvil-engineering-workbench mcp start` in `.cursor/mcp.json`
- **Antigravity:** Add server in `.gemini/mcp.json` (see docs/integrations/antigravity.md)
- **Windsurf:** Add server in `.windsurf/mcp_config.json`
- **VS Code:** Add server in `.vscode/mcp.json`
